Sugar typically tastes sweet. It has a clean, pleasant sweetness that is often used as a standard for comparing other sweet flavors. Depending on the type of sugar (such as white, brown, or raw), it may also have subtle notes of caramel, molasses, or creaminess, but the primary and dominant taste is sweet.
